$comment: releaseId is the published POC release. lastRun is still null until the real evaluation date is supplied — do not invent it. CI should overwrite this file on each gated release. See data/evals.schema.json.

ciGate.basis: 1,213 Langfuse-scored decisions, all gate.correct = 1, golden dataset of 500+ confirmed lines

scores.label: Recall@10
scores.detail: correct GL code in the top 10 retrieved lines

reading.line: A score out of 10 for whether the answer stays grounded in the text that was retrieved. The published average is 9.1. A RAG release below 9.0 does not ship.
How often the correct GL code is among the 10 historical lines the retriever returned. 100% means it was in that top 10 on every line in the golden set.
1 means the gate was right: an auto-posted code was correct, or an uncertain line was sent to a person. All 1,213 scored decisions are 1.
